BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 1,215,320 ordinary shares on 15 June 2026 for an average price of 252.38 pence per share, 1,150,660 ordinary shares on 16 June 2026 at an average price of 245.93 pence per share, and 1,241,553 ordinary shares on 17 June 2026 at an average price of 241.55 pence per share, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The company also repurchased 1,241,553 ordinary shares on 18 June 2026 at an average price of 236.03 pence and 1,280,000 ordinary shares on 19 June 2026 at an average price of 235.41 pence. Following these transactions, Serco Group plc has 983,947,333 ordinary shares in issue, with 18,798,681 held in treasury. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 19 June 2026 19 June 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 18,798,681 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 19 June 2026 is 983,947,333 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 18,798,681 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
